user.title: Connect to Matter Hub
user.description: Home Assistant Matter Hub is installed as an app. Connect to it, or to a Matter Hub running somewhere else.

menu_options.app: Matter Hub app on this Home Assistant
menu_options.direct: Matter Hub at a URL (Docker or standalone)

app.title: Matter Hub app
app.description: Requests go through the app's Home Assistant ingress, so no port needs to be opened. Fill in a username and password only if you turned on authentication in Matter Hub's settings.

direct.title: Matter Hub URL
direct.description: Enter the address of the Matter Hub web interface (port 8482 by default). See {project_url} for installing Matter Hub.

reauth_confirm.title: Matter Hub needs a password
reauth_confirm.description: Matter Hub now asks for a username and password.

error.app_not_running: The Matter Hub app is not running. Start it and try again.

abort.different_hub: This URL points to a different Matter Hub. Add it as a new integration instead.

action_failed.message: Matter Hub could not do that: {error}

app_unavailable.title: Matter Hub app isn't available
app_unavailable.description:
Matter Bridge can't reach the Matter Hub app for **{title}**: {error}.

Start the app under **Settings → Apps**. If you uninstalled it or moved Matter Hub to another install, open **Settings → Devices & services → Matter Bridge** and choose **Reconfigure**. This repair goes away once Matter Hub answers again.
